newsitem.title: USA: Dominican opposition leader in U.S. hospital.
newsitem.headline: Dominican opposition leader in U.S. hospital.

text.p: Dominican Republic opposition leader Jose Francisco Pena Gomez underwent surgery on Tuesday at a New York City cancer hospital, a hospital spokeswoman said.
Pena Gomez, 59, who has had surgery twice for stomach cancer, had a feeding tube inserted during the operation at Memorial Sloan-Kettering Cancer Centre in Manhattan, the spokeswoman said.

According to press reports in the Dominican Republic, the operation was intended to clear an obstruction in his digestive track. Local Dominican press reports also said due to his illness, Pena Gomez had been unable to eat for about 10 days.
The hospital spokeswoman, who did not provide further details of the surgery, said the operation had been completed satisfactorily and Pena Gomez was awake and in stable condition.
She said he checked into the hospital on Sunday and would remain in the hospital "for a period of time sufficient for his recovery."
Pena Gomez underwent surgery in New York on September 24 to remove a cancerous tumour lodged in his stomach. He had a similar operation in October 1994 in a hospital in Cleveland, Ohio.
He is president of the social democratic Dominican Revolutionary Party and president of the Socialist International for Latin America and the Caribbean.

Since 1990 he has been the party's presidential candidate three times, losing all three races, most recently to Dominican President Leonel Fernandez of the Dominican Liberation Party, who was inaugurated in August. He was narrowly defeated in a vote clouded by allegations of scandal by former president Joaquin Balaguer in 1994, an election that prompted a major reform of Dominican election law.

According to press reports in the Dominican Republic, Pena Gomez travelled to New York from Caracas, where he had been receiving treatment, on an airplane loaned to him by Venezuelan President Rafael Caldera, and received a visit from Carlos Andres Perez, the former president of Venezuela.
